query: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM git_deliveries g JOIN effects e ON e.effect_id = g.delivery_id JOIN conversations owner ON owner.conversation_id = g.conversation_id JOIN conversations target ON target.conversation_id = ?1 WHERE (owner.conversation_id = target.conversation_id OR (owner.working_tree = 'local_checkout' AND target.working_tree = 'local_checkout' AND owner.project_id = target.project_id)) AND (e.state IN ('pending', 'in_flight') OR (e.state = 'outcome_unknown' AND g.acknowledged = 0)))
